alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued November 23 at 3:58PM EST until November 26 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Miami FL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...A portion of southeast Florida, including the following
areas, Coastal Broward County, Coastal Miami Dade County, Coastal
Palm Beach County, Metro Broward County, Metro Palm Beach County
and Metropolitan Miami Dade.

* WHEN...From Tuesday evening through late Wednesday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The last 30 days of rainfall has been 400 to 600 percent of
normal across portions of Palm Beach and Broward Counties, and
between 200 to 300 percent of normal across portions of
Miami-Dade County. This amount of rainfall has made the ground
very saturated over the east coast metro areas of South Florida,

fl511_all: Tampa Bay | Hillsborough | Tampa: All travel lanes on eastbound I-4 from Exit 7 (US 301/US 92) to east of Exit 9 (I-75) to close tonight, Nov 23rd from 10 p.m. to 5.a.m. (next morning - weather permitting) for safety and operational improvement project. Follow the posted detour or seek alternate routes. | Nov 23 2026, 3:33 PM

Tampa Bay | Hillsborough | Tampa: Westbound I-4 travel lanes through the Downtown Tampa Interchange (SB I-275) will close tonight, Monday, Nov 23rd, from 10 p.m., to 5 a.m. (next morning - weather permitting) for maintenance activities. Detour via northbound I-275 to Exit 46B SR 574 turn left, left onto Tampa St, and re-enter southbound I-275. | Nov 23 2026, 3:48 PM

Tampa Bay | Hillsborough | Tampa: Northbound I-275 ramp to Tampa International Airport will close tonight, Monday, Nov 23rd from 10 p.m. to 5.a.m. (next morning - weather permitting) for crash cushion repairs. Use Exit 39 Kennedy Blvd, left turn onto westbound SR 60 to access the airport. | Nov 23 2026, 3:43 PM
